problem_restatement: Predeclare when a quiet v52 run should trigger technical review, cadence reassessment, or material frequency-deviation investigation using actual frozen route timestamps rather than operator impatience.

method.signal_identity: Unique causal signal_time_utc within each frozen continuous evidence partition.
method.interarrival_definition: Elapsed hours between consecutive unique signals inside one partition; gaps between disjoint evidence partitions are excluded.
method.bounded_no_event_definition: Partition-start to first signal, consecutive signal gaps, and last signal to partition-end.
method.quantile_method: Linear interpolation over sorted elapsed-hour observations.
method.planning_sensitivity: Homogeneous Poisson zero-event probability using the previously frozen combined central and optimistic-upper route rates; diagnostic only.

prospective_review_schedule.action: Technical-health and telemetry review only. Reconcile every provider evaluation, coverage, faults, freshness headroom, and venue state; do not infer a frequency defect from zero entries.

Cadence reassessment. Recompute exact eligible entries per route and side, regime exposure, blocker episodes, occupancy, and source coverage. Zero entries are informative but not alone proof of broken logic.

Material cadence-deviation investigation if technical coverage remained complete. Diagnose regime shift, source mismatch, parameter translation, data quality, or implementation defects before proposing any route change.

immediate_review_overrides: Any eligible decision without a routed action or explicit withheld/rejected outcome.
Any entry submitted after its configured maximum delay.
Any unexpected order, leverage, position, missing protective stop, or unresolved venue state.
Any source identity mismatch, technical gap, corrupted ledger row, or runtime fault.
The first filled entry and every completed lifecycle, regardless of elapsed schedule.

interpretation.current_1_680924_hour_window: Shorter than the minimum observed within-partition interarrival for every route and therefore not evidence of cadence failure.
interpretation.important_limit: Activation can occur at any phase inside a historical interval, so the observed minimum interarrival is not a guaranteed minimum wait to the next signal.
interpretation.decision: Use the schedule as evidence-review timing, not as an automatic gate, route relaxation, or profitability claim.

recommendation.recommendation: Keep the frozen routes and use the 24-hour, 7-day, and 14-day evidence-review schedule while auditing the first eligible event immediately.
recommendation.why_now: A predeclared review clock prevents both premature gate loosening and indefinite acceptance of a genuine frequency collapse.
recommendation.evidence_reviewed: Exact Hulk replay trades, exact sweep path signal times, HYPE aligned-only trade sidecar, frozen route-cadence journal, and the opening live cadence diagnosis.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The routes are intentionally sparse; the operational need is distinguishing normal silence from a material cadence deviation.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: All regimes observed prospectively under the unchanged v52 route contracts; route-specific conclusions still require regime attribution at each review.
recommendation.alternatives_considered: Daily trade quotas, timeframe-based frequency assumptions, indefinite waiting, a single Poisson threshold, or empirical timestamps plus staged review thresholds.
recommendation.expected_upside: Faster detection of real data/translation/regime problems without sacrificing selectivity merely to increase activity.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Nonstationary cadence, correlated route silence, small route samples, disjoint evidence windows, and mistaking a review trigger for proof of a defect.
recommendation.validation_completed: Unique signal timestamps and within-partition gaps were reconciled from frozen source artifacts; central and upper-rate zero-event sensitivities were independently recomputed.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Prospective eligible entries, both HYPE sides, BTC occupancy interactions, and actual interarrival behavior under the active v52 run.
recommendation.success_metrics: Every scheduled review completes with exact coverage and route/side attribution, and every eligible event is fully reconciled without unsupported parameter changes.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any immediate-review override, or zero entries at 14 days with complete coverage, triggers a new diagnosis and approval-ready proposal if a validated repair exists.
recommendation.confidence_level: high on the timestamp arithmetic; medium on review-threshold usefulness; low on future profitability and stationarity

falsifier: Replace the schedule if prospective v52 interarrivals, exact regime exposure, or route/source identity demonstrate materially different cadence, or if a technical fault explains the quiet window.
